easyNIS

easyNIS opens annual HCUP National Inpatient Sample (NIS) files and helps you define discharge cohorts. Use it to estimate national totals, fit survey-weighted models, and review results for disclosure.

Install 

pak::pak("MSaadAsif/easyNIS")

Estimate a cohort total

This example uses invented data.

library(easyNIS)
library(dplyr)
library(srvyr)
nis <- nis_open(nis_example(years = 2019:2020)) |>
  nis_flag_dx(heart_failure = "I50")
design <- nis_design(nis, cohort = AGE >= 18 & heart_failure, keep = LOS)
filtered <- nis_design(filter(nis, AGE >= 18, heart_failure), cohort = TRUE, keep = LOS)
bind_rows(cohort = summarise(design, discharges = survey_total()),
          prefiltered = summarise(filtered, discharges = survey_total()), .id = "design")

Both designs estimate the same weighted total. Their standard errors differ. Pass eligibility to cohort to account for every sampled hospital. See the two calculations side by side.

Using real NIS files

Unpack each annual Core file and convert it with nis_convert(). Open the Parquet directory with nis_open(). Keep the files in your private workspace. The HCUP Data Use Agreement prohibits publishing cells based on 1 through 10 discharges.
